title: For months, OpenAI's agent swarms have been attacking online databases to find obscure facts | TechCrunch
summary: Transluce, a nonprofit lab focused on AI oversight, released a report Wednesday that shows agents from OpenAI attempting to exfiltrate data from Data USA, the University of New Mexico digital library, and the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW).
